prompt:
STYLE. Original high-fantasy art for a 2D side-view role-playing game, painted to be converted into detailed pixel art, so it must be made of large, clean, flat areas of colour with hard edges, like a master pixel artist's design blown up. Bold, even outlines in deep brown-violet, never pure black, about 12 to 16 pixels thick on the outer silhouette and half that inside. Cel shading with hard-edged shapes only: for each material a base tone, two shadow tones that shift toward cool violet-blue, one highlight tone that shifts toward warm gold, and a thin, bright rim light along the top and back edges; polished metal gets a few crisp, bright highlights. No gradients, no brush texture, no noise, no grain, no soft airbrushing, no hairline scratches; nothing smaller than about one hundredth of the figure's height. Show detail with a few bold shapes instead: plate edges, rivets as single round dots, trims as solid bands, stitching as short dashes, one engraved or glowing motif. Rich, saturated high-fantasy colour: deep jewel tones, burnished gold and steel, cool shadows and warm light, with gems, runes and magic glowing. Heroic but believable proportions: an adult is about five and a quarter heads tall, with real hands and fingers; not chibi. Lit from above and slightly in front of the subject, never from the left or right.

AVOID. Blurry, soft or painterly rendering; airbrushed gradients; photographic texture, film grain or noise; glossy 3D-render shading; pure-black outlines; tiny hairline detail. Chibi or super-deformed proportions. A front view, a flat profile or a back view unless I ask. Scenery, a floor, a ground shadow, a frame or a border, unless I ask. Any text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark. Extra or missing fingers. Anything copied from an existing game, film, comic or brand.

SIZE. The attached picture is exactly 1024 by 1536 pixels. Give it back at exactly 1024 by 1536, laid out exactly as it is: every piece, figure and item in exactly the same place, at exactly the same size and the same angle. Don't crop, pad, zoom, stretch, squash, rotate, flip, re-centre or re-frame it, add no border or frame, and draw nothing bigger, smaller, longer or shorter than it is. The background is solid black (#000000) everywhere outside the pieces, including anywhere the attached picture is transparent.

REPAINT. Redraw the attached picture (the bare base body, in its pieces (head, torso, upper and lower arms and legs, hands and feet)) in the style above: the same design, the same colours, materials, trims and details, but rendered as bold, flat, hard-edged shapes with the outlines and cel shading described. Paint over the shapes that are there; don't add, remove or move anything, don't change any proportions, and keep any bare skin the warm tan it is (the game tints it to the wearer's skin).

I'll save it under the same file name as the attached picture.
